attributes.residual: 4 lines, ONE named mechanism. MWCC's front end reassociates p + i*K + C to p + (i*K + C) and discards the source's written associativity when the intermediate `base + i*K` pointer is SINGLE-USE; target's add-then-addi form survives only when that intermediate is read at a second site first (positive control, same TU, byte-exact: StartMagicHealFX reads lwz 2996(pre-offset) between its two steps; the transplant of that idiom into StartBlockFX in this same session converted the identical cluster and moved it STRUCTURAL -> REGISTER_ONLY). StartGenHitFx's target has no second use available, so no source spelling reaches it. NOT WEBFRANK-READY: the streams differ in real instructions (add r4,r31,r0 vs addi r4,r3,2976), not in schedule or colour, so neither the permutation stage nor the register stage is applicable - do not flag it.
